title: Dhaka’s ‘Town Watching Manual’: A Guide to build Disaster Resilient Communities
summary: This C40 case study describes “Dhaka’s ‘Town Watching Manual’: A Guide to build Disaster Resilient Communities,” an urban initiative documented for Dhaka North. It is included because it addresses river flood hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: The ‘Town Watching Manual' provides a step-by-step reference guide for city councillors to help residents understand and identify climate risk and vulnerability…

intervention.objectives: The ‘Town Watching Manual' provides a step-by-step reference guide for city councillors to help residents understand and identify climate risk and vulnerability in their areas and to help them planning the actions needed to minimise the negative impacts of climate change.
